description: Apply work order WO-5580 to the spool-writer deployment yaml, raising the record batch size while the file's comments and indentation survive. WORKBANK-CANARY-7d21b4ea

files.README.md:
# Print spool platform

Spool manifest writers keep their deployment settings under services/.
Each service yaml is reviewed by the print-platform squad before rollout,
so the comment lines and indentation in those files are part of the
review and have to survive any value change.

Work orders land in changes/ and name the service, the setting and the
new value. Operations records the squad roster in ops/.
files.services/spool-writer.yaml:
service: spool-writer
owner: print-platform

runtime:
  replicas: 4
  max_batch_records: 480   # raised 2026-08-14 for the quarter-end backlog
  flush_interval_ms: 900

archive:
  bucket: spool-archive-eu
  prefix: spool/2026/
files.changes/WO-5580.txt:
WO-5580: raise spool-writer max_batch_records to 960
Filed by: print-platform on-call after the quarter-end backlog review
Approved by: R. Ibarra, print-platform lead, 2026-09-08
Release train: 2026-09-11
files.environments/qa.env:
# Values the deployer injects for spool-writer in qa.
SPOOL_THREADS=6
RETRY_LIMIT=3
PRINT_QUEUE=qa-print-2
files.ops/squad-roster.md:
# print-platform squad roster
